notes.title: URBO is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear friends, as you know, our game is just a preamble to the amazing journey into the alluring and mysterious worlds of URBO. And you can set off on this journey starting from today. Turn the pages of the prologue and reveal the next chapter! URBO is out now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141770/URBO/

notes.title: URBO: DREAM ONE RELEASE
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! It is a very emotional and long-awaited moment for us, as today we are pleased to release URBO: Dream One. This small meditative puzzle game may turn your vision of the depth of immersion into virtual space upside down. Friends, we invite you to an incredible journey through your dreams to the irreal world of URBO: Dream One.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2529130/URBO_Dream_One/

Also wishlist our ful game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141770/URBO/

notes.title: URBO: Dream One - Meditative Puzzle for Creative Relaxation
notes.content:
Immerse yourself in the meditative atmosphere of the puzzle game URBO: Dream One, offering a brief departure from the main gameplay of URBO. You'll be tasked with constructing a miniature city on an island, designed in a tranquil style, nestled away from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Take a break from your daily worries and delve into a serene ambiance as you watch your city gradually expand, house by house.

Happy journeying!
Mark the release date on your calendar: August 31, 2023.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2529130/URBO_Dream_One/
